|gr1= GUI Control - ListNBox

|descr= Adds a column at given position.

|s1= control [[lnbAddColumn]] position

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|p2= position: [[Number]] - position of the new column where 0 means all the way to the left and 1 all the way to the right of the control

|r1= [[Number]] or [[Nothing]] - returns the zero based index of the new column

|s2= [[lnbAddColumn]] [controlOrIdc, position]

|p21= controlOrIdc: [[Control]] or [[Number]] - control or the idc of the control

|p22= position: [[Number]] - position of the new column where 0 means all the way to the left and 1 all the way to the right of the control

|r2= [[Number]] or [[Nothing]] - returns the zero based index of the new column

|x1= <sqf>_ctrl lnbAddColumn 0.8;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>lnbAddColumn [105, 0.8];</sqf>
